artifact_set_manifest_sha256_scope: SHA-256 of artifact_set serialized as UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, compact separators, no ASCII escaping, and no trailing newline; excludes this wrapper and digest fields. This hashes the inventory descriptor, not the actual model bytes.

artifact_set.scope: five model weight shards only; does not include tokenizer, configuration, license or runtime artifacts

limitations: The shard SHA-256 values are published by the upstream Hugging Face file pages at the pinned revision and have not been independently recomputed from locally downloaded artifact bytes in this environment.
The computed digest identifies the canonical five-shard inventory descriptor, not a bytewise concatenation of the model files.
The inventory excludes tokenizer/config/runtime files and therefore is not a complete runtime package manifest.
The model-license gate does not currently validate this evidence file or define its manifest digest as an accepted artifact_sha256 representation.
Product-owner model/deployment selection, exact terms/AUP review, dataset/provenance review, compatibility/security/task evaluation, and explicit human approval remain outstanding.
acceptance_next_steps: Authorize or reject this exact model and deployment mode in issue #1317.
Acquire the exact pinned artifacts through a controlled pipeline and independently recompute each file SHA-256 against the upstream values.
Expand or define the canonical bundle manifest for every runtime file included in the deployed model package, then validate the digest in code.
Only after evidence review and explicit approval, update the production model manifest and run test:model-license and test:model-license:release on the exact candidate SHA.
